messages:
Luca Moretti: Hey folks, received the orientation invite but my calendar shows two entries (Nov 20 and Nov 21). Anyone else seeing duplicates?
Ivy Chen: Hi @Luca - are both from the same organizer? We schedule a global session and a regional repeat, some clients create two events when they auto-accept both.
Luca Moretti: Both say 'Orientation - Redwood Welcome' but one has location 'Orientation - EMEA' and the other 'Orientation - Global'. I'm in Lisbon (WET). Which one should I keep?
Carlos Mendes: Keep the EMEA one if you're in Lisbon. The global event is mostly for APAC folks and sometimes appears in everyone's calendar due to RSVP mirroring.
Luca Moretti: Cool. The ICS for the EMEA event has DTSTART:20241120T100000+0000 but my Outlook shows 11:00. Is that a daylight savings thing?
Ivy Chen: That ICS timestamp uses an offset rather than an explicit TZID. Outlook sometimes applies local DST rules differently. The canonical time is 10:00 WET (Lisbon) / 11:00 CET. We're listing times on the invite description like: "10:00 WET / 11:00 CET / 18:00 HKT" to avoid confusion.
OnboardBot: Note: Recording will be uploaded to the onboarding Drive at https://files.redwood.ai/onboarding/2024-fall within 3 hours of session end. If you can't attend, watch the recording and mark the onboarding checklist step as complete.
Luca Moretti: Thanks @OnboardBot. Can someone re-export the ICS with TZID=Europe/Lisbon? My phone calendar keeps flipping it to local time and creating duplicates.
HR Ops: On it. I'll regenerate the EMEA ICS with explicit TZIDs for Europe/Lisbon and Europe/Berlin and re-send. Also adding line in description: "If you see duplicates, keep the event with location 'Orientation - EMEA'. Delete the one with location 'Orientation - Global'."
Ivy Chen: FYI we also added a short blurb in the invite: "If your calendar shows two entries, check the location field and accept only the one matching your region."
Carlos Mendes: Quick troubleshooting tip: on Outlook Web, open the event > More actions > Edit > see "Time zone" dropdown. If it shows a different zone, manually set to the correct one and re-save.
Luca Moretti: Got the new invite, looks correct now (shows Nov 20 10:00 WET). Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Ivy Chen: We'll follow up post-session with the recording link and a short transcript. See you there!
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours before and 30 minutes before. :bell:
